argumentTemplates.title: Argument templates
argumentTemplates.description: Save common launch arguments and select a template in instance settings.
argumentTemplates.precedence: Argument priority: global settings → template → instance override. Each layer replaces the entire JVM or game argument string. An enabled, empty instance override clears that group of arguments.
argumentTemplates.inUse: This template is in use. Unbind it in instance settings before removing it.
argumentTemplates.name: Template name (1–48 characters)
argumentTemplates.environmentHelp: Up to 64 variables. Names use letters, digits or underscores, cannot start with a digit, and must be unique; names are case-insensitive on Windows. Values preserve whitespace, newlines and empty strings, up to 8192 bytes. Enter Java options in JVM arguments.
argumentTemplates.draftHelp: Apply the template to the settings draft, then use Save settings on this page. Cancel keeps the previously applied template.
argumentTemplates.environmentPrecedence: Inherit the system environment, merge template variables, then apply instance variables by name. An instance value replaces the template value; an empty value sets it to empty. Removing an instance variable restores inheritance.
